start.args:
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime, json, os, shutil, signal, socket, subprocess, sys, threading, time
import urllib.request
OUT, CFG, LOG = "/tmp/burger-groundtruth.json", "/tmp/burger-gt.ini", "/tmp/burger-gt-monitor.log"
ES = ("172.16.0.1", 19200)
EP = "udp://239.0.0.1:40000"
POINTS = int("400000")
RATE = int("10000")
MAXG = int("200")
R = str(int(time.time()))[-6:]
res = {"error": None, "expected": 11, "checks": [], "data": {"run": R, "endpoint": EP},
       "client": None, "pybennu": None}
mon = None
open(LOG, "w").close()  # the recv below needs a file even when the monitor never starts

def check(name, ok, detail):
    res["checks"].append({"name": name, "ok": bool(ok), "detail": detail})
    print(("ok   " if ok else "FAIL ") + name + ": " + detail, flush=True)
    return ok

def es(method, path, body=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request("http://%s:%d%s" % (ES[0], ES[1], path),
                                 data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                 method=method, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read() or b"{}")

def count(prefix):
    es("POST", "/bennu-*/_refresh")
    q = {"query": {"prefix": {"device.keyword": prefix}}}
    return es("POST", "/bennu-*/_count", q).get("count", 0)

def docs(prefix, n=3):
    es("POST", "/bennu-*/_refresh")
    q = {"size": n, "query": {"prefix": {"device.keyword": prefix}}}
    return es("POST", "/bennu-*/_search", q)["hits"]["hits"]

def rss_mb(pid):
    for ln in open("/proc/%d/status" % pid):
        if ln.startswith("VmRSS"):
            return int(ln.split()[1]) / 1024.0
    return 0.0

class Proxy:
    def __init__(self):
        self.srv, self.conns, self.held, self.hold = None, [], [], False

    def up(self):
        s = socket.socket()
        s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 9200))
        s.listen(64)
        self.srv = s
        threading.Thread(target=self.accept, args=(s,), daemon=True).start()

    def accept(self, s):
        while True:
            try:
                c, _ = s.accept()
            except OSError:
                return
            if self.hold:  # an unreachable host: connected, never answered
                self.held.append(c)
                continue
            try:
                u = socket.create_connection(ES, timeout=10)
                u.settimeout(None)
            except OSError:
                c.close()
                continue
            self.conns += [c, u]
            threading.Thread(target=self.pipe, args=(c, u), daemon=True).start()
            threading.Thread(target=self.pipe, args=(u, c), daemon=True).start()

    def pipe(self, a, b):
        try:
            while True:
                d = a.recv(65536)
                if not d:
                    break
                b.sendall(d)
        except OSError:
            pass
        for x in (a, b):
            try:
                x.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
            except OSError:
                pass

    def hang(self):
        self.hold = True
        for c in self.conns:
            try:
                c.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
                c.close()
            except OSError:
                pass
        self.conns = []

    def release(self):
        self.hold = False
        for c in self.held:
            try:
                c.close()
            except OSError:
                pass
        self.held = []

    def down(self):
        try:
            self.srv.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
        except OSError:
            pass
        self.srv.close()
        for c in self.conns:
            try:
                c.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
                c.close()
            except OSError:
                pass
        self.conns = []

def alive():
    return mon is not None and mon.poll() is None

def tail():
    try:
        return open(LOG).read()[-600:].replace("\n", " | ")
    except OSError:
        return ""

try:
    import elasticsearch
    import pybennu
    res["client"] = ".".join(str(x) for x in elasticsearch.__version__)
    try:
        from importlib.metadata import version
        res["pybennu"] = version("pybennu")
    except Exception:
        res["pybennu"] = "?"
    es("GET", "/")  # the real Elasticsearch must answer on the docker host
    proxy = Proxy()
    proxy.up()
    open(CFG, "w").write("[groundtruth-monitor]\npublish-endpoint = %s\nelasticsearch-ip = 127.0.0.1\nfilter = /\n" % EP)
    env = dict(os.environ, TZ="Etc/GMT-14", BENNU_LOG_FILE="")
    exe = shutil.which("pybennu-groundtruth-monitor")
    lf = open(LOG, "wb")
    t0 = time.time()
    if exe:
        mon = subprocess.Popen([exe, "-c", CFG, "-e", "burger", "start"], env=env, stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        time.sleep(6)
    if not alive():
        why = "console script missing" if not exe else "exited %s: %s" % (mon.returncode, tail())
        check("monitor runs from the console script", False, why)
        # still try the module, to say whether the monitor itself can run
        mon = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "pybennu.executables.groundtruth_monitor", "-c", CFG, "-e", "burger", "start"],
                               env=env, stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        t0 = time.time()
        time.sleep(6)
        if not alive():
            check("monitor runs with elasticsearch-py " + res["client"], False, "exited %s: %s" % (mon.returncode, tail()))
            raise SystemExit
        check("monitor runs with elasticsearch-py " + res["client"], True, "module runs, pid %d" % mon.pid)
    else:
        check("monitor runs from the console script", True, "pid %d, elasticsearch-py %s" % (mon.pid, res["client"]))
        check("monitor runs with elasticsearch-py " + res["client"], True, "pid %d" % mon.pid)
    from pybennu.distributed.publisher import Publisher
    pub = Publisher(EP)
    time.sleep(1)

    # 1. a plain point: fields, index name, UTC timestamp
    pub.publish("gt%s-shape.v:1.5," % R)
    time.sleep(4)
    hits = docs("gt%s-shape" % R)
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    if hits:
        h = hits[0]
        src = h["_source"]
        ts = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(src["@timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if ts.tzinfo is None:
            ts = ts.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        off = (ts - now).total_seconds()
        res["data"]["doc"] = h
        want = ["@timestamp", "provider", "device", "field", "value"]
        check("documents have the expected fields", all(k in src for k in want) and src["device"] == "gt%s-shape" % R and src["field"] == "v" and src["value"] == 1.5,
              "keys %s" % sorted(src))
        check("index is bennu-<UTC date>", h["_index"] == "bennu-" + now.strftime("%Y.%m.%d"),
              "%s, UTC date %s (monitor TZ is UTC+14)" % (h["_index"], now.strftime("%Y.%m.%d")))
        check("@timestamp is UTC", abs(off) < 120, "%s is %+.0f s from UTC now" % (src["@timestamp"], off))
    else:
        for nm in ("documents have the expected fields", "index is bennu-<UTC date>", "@timestamp is UTC"):
            check(nm, False, "no document for gt%s-shape" % R)

    # 2. an alert point inside the 30 s window must not drop the rest of the message
    pub.publish("gt%s-alert.state:1,gt%s-bus1.v:1.5,gt%s-bus2.v:2.5," % (R, R, R))
    time.sleep(4)
    n = count("gt%s-bus" % R)
    check("rate-limited alert keeps the other points", n == 2, "%d of 2 points after an alert-first message %.0f s after start" % (n, time.time() - t0))

    # 3. an alert passes once the window (30 s from start) has passed
    time.sleep(max(0, 33 - (time.time() - t0)))
    pub.publish("gt%s-alert2.state:2,gt%s-bus3.v:3.5," % (R, R))
    time.sleep(4)
    a2, b3 = count("gt%s-alert2" % R), count("gt%s-bus3" % R)
    check("an alert after the window is ingested", a2 == 1 and b3 == 1, "alert %d, other point %d" % (a2, b3))

    # 4. the provider's own stream lands (anything not ours)
    es("POST", "/bennu-*/_refresh")
    tot = es("POST", "/bennu-*/_count", {}).get("count", 0)
    ours = es("POST", "/bennu-*/_count", {"query": {"prefix": {"device.keyword": "gt" + R}}}).get("count", 0)
    res["data"]["provider_docs"] = tot - ours
    check("the provider's stream lands", tot - ours > 0, "%d documents not from this test" % (tot - ours))

    # 5. Elasticsearch refuses connections for 8 s: the batch popped meanwhile must be retried
    proxy.down()
    pub.publish("".join("gt%s-first%d.v:%d.0," % (R, i, i) for i in range(10)))
    time.sleep(8)
    proxy.up()
    end = time.time() + 60
    first = 0
    while time.time() < end:
        time.sleep(3)
        try:
            first = count("gt%s-first" % R)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if first >= 10:
            break
    res["data"]["first_docs"] = first
    check("a batch that failed during an outage is retried", first == 10, "%d of 10 points arrived within 60 s of recovery" % first)

    # 6. Elasticsearch unreachable (connects, never answers): memory must stay bounded
    rss = [("start", round(rss_mb(mon.pid), 1))]
    proxy.hang()
    sent, step, mark, t1 = 0, POINTS // 6, POINTS // 6, time.time()
    while sent < POINTS:
        pub.publish("".join("gt%s-flood.v%d:%d.0," % (R, sent + i, i) for i in range(100)))
        sent += 100
        if sent >= mark:
            rss.append((sent, round(rss_mb(mon.pid), 1)))
            mark += step
        nap = t1 + sent / RATE - time.time()
        if nap > 0:
            time.sleep(nap)
    time.sleep(3)
    rss.append(("end", round(rss_mb(mon.pid), 1)))
    res["data"]["rss_mb"] = rss
    grew = max(v for _, v in rss) - rss[0][1]
    check("monitor memory is bounded while Elasticsearch is unreachable", mon.poll() is None and grew <= MAXG,
          "peak RSS +%.0f MB (limit %d) after %d points; RSS MB %s" % (grew, MAXG, POINTS, ", ".join("%s=%s" % x for x in rss)))

    # 7. Elasticsearch reachable again: documents resume
    proxy.release()
    n = 0
    end = time.time() + 180
    while time.time() < end and n < 1:
        pub.publish("gt%s-after.v:1.0," % R)
        time.sleep(6)
        try:
            n = count("gt%s-after" % R)
        except Exception:
            pass
    res["data"]["flood_docs"] = count("gt%s-flood" % R)
    check("documents resume after Elasticsearch returns", n >= 1, "%d fresh point(s) landed; %d of %d flood points landed" % (n, res["data"]["flood_docs"], POINTS))
    res["data"]["retry_log_lines"] = open(LOG).read().count("will retry")
except SystemExit:
    pass
except Exception as e:
    res["error"] = "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)
finally:
    try:
        if mon is not None and mon.poll() is None:
            mon.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
            mon.wait(10)
    except Exception:
        pass
    res["data"]["monitor_log_tail"] = tail()
    json.dump(res, open(OUT, "w"))
    print(json.dumps(res)[:3000])
PY
